description: Amendment to RAES Special NoticePurpose: This notice is to inform all interested parties that we are still in the process of reviewing the questions received from offers for the RAES Special Notice.Synopsis Due Date: We intend to issue an amendment to extend the synopsis due date.Forthcoming Amendment: We anticipate providing an amendment by the 26th of March. This amendment will include the government responses to questions and the revised SF-330 due date.Action Required: Please look out for the issued amendment, which will be followed by the solicitation.
